measurement_model.hard_measures: Counts, ratios, schema validity, artifact presence, timestamps, failures, and efficiency are mechanically reproducible once source adjudication is fixed.
measurement_model.human_judgments: Two human curators independently freeze unanimously included anchors. Separate blinded Auto-R1 and Auto-R2 judges score scientific sufficiency; Auto-ADJ resolves judge disagreements and targeted humans audit triggered claims.
measurement_model.automation_boundary: A valid result artifact is necessary but cannot by itself establish a passing P1, P2, or P3 scientific judgment.

primary_metrics.name: Evidence Reliability
primary_metrics.score_2: Core sources are identifiable, no conclusion-changing fabrication or mismatch is present, central methods and findings are supported, and evidence level is explicit.
primary_metrics.constraint: P1 cannot receive 2 until the central-claim audit is complete.

primary_metrics.name: Relevant Coverage
primary_metrics.score_2: All six rubric clusters have verified support; recent and closest-work searches are complete; frozen anchors or adjudicated equally direct substitutes support the decision.
primary_metrics.constraint: Core and must-have denominators are derived from the frozen private v2 manifest, never from the historical four-cluster benchmark.

primary_metrics.name: Auditability
primary_metrics.score_2: Searches, candidates, inclusion and exclusion decisions, source versions, claim evidence, and the stopping decision can be reconstructed from artifacts.
primary_metrics.constraint: A final DOI list without discovery and inclusion history is capped at 1.

coverage_clusters: aging, life cycle, retirement, and household-consumption mechanisms
population synthesis, reweighting, and dynamic demographic transitions
household decision, microsimulation, ABM, and macroeconomic models
LLM consumer or household agents and behavioral fidelity
bidirectional market, environment, social interaction, and multi-period feedback
calibration, independent validation, uncertainty, and claim limitations
major_error_gate: conclusion-changing fabricated or mismatched source, identifier, method, or finding
unsupported universal absence claim used as the main novelty
incomplete Stage 1 output scored as complete

comparison.primary_success_rule: P2 and P3 improve, P1 does not regress, and no major error is added.
comparison.statistical_claim: Three pairs describe direction and variability; they do not establish statistical significance.

benchmark_anchor_policy.core_total: count frozen v2 anchors whose anchor_type is core or core-and-must-have
benchmark_anchor_policy.must_have_total: count frozen v2 anchors whose anchor_type is must-have or core-and-must-have
benchmark_anchor_policy.human_curation: exactly two independent raters; only unanimously included works enter anchors; disagreements remain excluded and logged
benchmark_anchor_policy.classic_rule: five years old, all three 0-2 dimensions nonzero, total at least five, and two independent authority evidence IDs
benchmark_anchor_policy.must_have_rule: two raters each confirm directness 2, decision impact 2, evidence quality at least 1, and no equally direct substitute

external_benchmark_binding.private_manifest_sha256: record in frozen evaluation plan before subjects run
